significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would establish that alarming cues "fire the refusal-execution circuit directly, bypassing the model's internal harmfulness assessment," while harmful requests instead recruit the harmfulness pathway: a form-(ii) causal decomposition of over-refusal and justified refusal into independently manipulable contributors, establishing both a behavioral phenomenon and its mechanism. This would constrain explanations and mitigation choices beyond individual prompts—refusal-axis suppression would be mechanistically overbroad, whereas trigger-pathway suppression should selectively alter false refusals—addressing the failure measured by XSTest (Röttger et al., 2024) and OR-Bench (Cui et al., 2024) and refining the single-direction account exemplified by Arditi et al. (2024). The branches are distinguishable: a negative result would rule out the proposed clean bypass mechanism, although it would not identify which entangled or alternative mechanism causes over-refusal. After substituting the broad safety-interpretability topic for the specific three-pathway claim, this score would not remain justified; the causal split between two refusal behaviors is the above-median increment.

reach.justification: The concrete handle is the "trigger-salience component of the residual stream" and the associated inference-time intervention that "ablates only the trigger-salience component ... while preserving harmfulness belief"; it is ex ante because it operates before the model produces a refusal, leaving an action window for deployment. The conclusion predicts a transferable relation after per-model re-extraction—trigger-pathway contribution should dominate benign trigger cases while harmfulness-belief contribution should dominate genuinely harmful cases—rather than merely supplying an unstructured search procedure, although the claim itself concedes that the substance may be "model-family dependent" and leaves frontier-model transfer unstated. Downstream users include researchers and practitioners who tune or ship refusal safeguards, since the claimed training-free knob directly targets the safety-versus-helpfulness tradeoff represented in XSTest and OR-Bench. Topic substitution would erase the named component, predictive decomposition, and deployment knob, so the reach score comes from claim-specific handles rather than the general importance of LLM safety.
